cases.refreshed: Participating in the Reading to Children program is a great way for children to develop their imagination and spark a love for books, reading, and learning. It can also help them reach academic success. Children will enjoy one-on-one or small-group interaction with our adult volunteer. They are also welcome to practice reading to our volunteer. Pre-registration is not required, and children may drop in to hear a story any time during the program. This program is best suited for preschoolers and children in grades K-3 and will be held in the Children's Area. Free. No registration required.

cases.refreshed: Discover a soothing, slow-paced Vinyasa practice that combines mindful movement, body awareness, and relaxation to help you connect with your body and find calm. Presented by Jessica, a Certified Yoga Instructor. Note: This class is not designed for prenatal yoga. Free. No registration required. Bring your own mat. Optional: Bring 2 yoga blocks and a small/medium blanket or pillow for additional comfort and support. Attendance tickets will be available 30 minutes before the start of class at the Information Desk. Attendees will be required to sign an Exercise Program Waiver and Release of Liability form.

cases.refreshed: Did the fandom that used to be your absolute fave stop sparking joy for you? Have you hopped multiple fandoms over the years? Are your old acrylic standees, figurines, keychain charms, pins, prints, or stickers taking up too much space for the things from your new fandoms? Did you just clean out your room and ended up with massive piles of non-recyclable fandom merch you no longer want? Cambrian Branch Library has got you covered with Fandom Swap! We meet on the last Sunday of every month from 2 to 4 PM. Come bring in your clean, gently-loved fandom merchandise to find them new homes and keep them out of landfills! There's no need to stay for the full duration of this program either. Feel free to come by and drop off your stuff and leave, or if you'd like, you can stick around and see what other people bring in! So come join us to clean out your fandom goodies, meet fellow fans, or discover new fandoms! Official and unofficial merch are welcome, but all materials must be rated PG-13 and under. Selling is prohibited in this program.

cases.refreshed: Queer joy shall abound at the Queer Café! Let's grab our chunky knit sweaters, a warm cup of something pumpkin-spiced, and celebrate the fall season for November's Queer Cafe. Queer Cafe is an LGBTQ+ friendly space in our community room for folks to gather, read, craft, and chat. A selection of queer reading materials will be available to browse and checkout. In addition to light snacks and refreshments, we'll have craft supplies and a selection of cozy and found family reads highlighting queer characters and authors. While the intention of this program is to create a safe and comfortable space for patrons identifying as LGBTQ+, we welcome all participants and reading materials. Café Queer ¡La alegría queer estará presente en cada rincón del Café Queer! ¡Pongámonos nuestros suéteres gruesos de punto, disfrutemos de una bebida calientita con especias de calabaza y celebremos la temporada de otoño en el Café Queer de noviembre! El Café Queer es un espacio acogedor para la comunidad LGBTQ+ en nuestra sala comunitaria, donde las personas pueden reunirse, leer, hacer manualidades y conversar. Habrá una selección de libros y otros materiales de lectura con temática LGBTQ+ disponibles para explorar y llevar en préstamo. Además de bocadillos y bebidas ligeras, tendremos materiales para manualidades y una selección de lecturas reconfortantes, incluidas historias sobre familias elegidas, que destacan a personajes y autores LGBTQ+. Se anima a las personas participantes a compartir y conocer a otros lectores con intereses similares, pero no se les pedirá que revelen su identidad ni sus preferencias de lectura. Aunque el propósito de este programa es crear un espacio seguro y cómodo para las personas que se identifican como LGBTQ+, todas las personas y todos los materiales de lectura son bienvenidos.

cases.refreshed: Improve your math skills and apply them through fun math-related activities! Participants will focus on a variety of math concepts and do hands-on math activities in this weekly drop-in program. For children in grades 3-5 only. No registration is required. Instruction on the week's concept will occur during the first 15-20 minutes, so please arrive on time. This program meets in person during the school year. We may cancel some meetings due to school/holiday breaks or volunteer unavailability.
